title: win.t1 (light demo, claimed zero sim change) re-blesses all 60 per-tick state hashes, not only the catalog_hash header line
detail: Light-demo invariant 'only the catalog_hash header line shifts in their .t1' is violated: all 60 per-tick hashes changed and the terminal static-state hash changed (5236757f14af384b to d8b7050d6663ee00), which neither documented reason (a) nor (b) accounts for.
recommended_fix: Confirm whether the per-tick FNV-1a-64 hash covers the catalog hash or lane state; if not this is unaccounted drift — restore win.t1 tick hashes.
